Amy stirred the sizzling eggs on her stove while Will tugged at his spoon and Amber giggled over toast crumbs. The kitchen hummed with ordinary morning chatter until an unsteady shuffling burst through the front door. A lone zombie, its eyes glazed white, staggered inside, a slow groan echoing off the walls.

Amy’s heart leapt; she scooped Will into her arms and pulled Amber behind her, both kids squealing as they ran toward the back stairwell. She shoved them into the small closet that served as their safe spot, slamming the door shut with a thud. The children hugged each other tight, breathing shallowly.

She stepped out onto the kitchen floor, wiping sweat from her brow. In the corner behind the fridge, she slipped open a hidden panel and pulled out a pistol, its matte black grip cool in her palm. When the last zombie finally collapsed at her feet, a single breath escaped from Amy’s lips; the kitchen was silent except for the thud of its body hitting the floorboards. She turned toward the closet door, where Will and Amber waited with wide eyes. The children stepped out into the hallway together as she followed them back to their safe spot.
